En Portal Místico queremos que sepas qué: At Portal Místico we want you to know what's behind every result. Here we explain, tool by tool, whether the result comes from a formula, is chosen from texts we wrote ourselves, or is drawn at random, and what the limits of each one are.
<strong>Importante:</strong> tarot, horó: Important: tarot, horoscopes, numerology, palmistry, auras, and dreams are symbolic practices. Our readings are for reflection and entertainment. They do not predict the future with certainty, and they are not a substitute for the advice of a doctor, lawyer, psychologist, or financial advisor.
Sorteo al azar entre las 78 cartas del t: Random draw from the 78 tarot cards. The meanings follow the Rider-Waite tradition and are written by us.
Textos redactados por nosotros para cada: Texts we wrote for each sign and time period. The text you see depends on your sign, the category (love, work, etc.), and the date. It is not calculated from the exact positions of the planets.
Cálculo astronómico con tu fecha, hora y: Astronomical calculation using your birth date, time, and place: positions of the Sun, Moon, and planets, rising sign, houses, and aspects.
Cálculo con el sistema pitagórico: se su: Calculation using the Pythagorean system: digits or letters are added up and reduced to a single digit, keeping the master numbers 11, 22, and 33.
La fase de la Luna se calcula a partir d: The Moon's phase is calculated from the mean lunar cycle. The rituals and retrogrades are guides we wrote ourselves.
La imagen de tu palma se procesa en tu p: The image of your palm is processed on your own device. The interpretations apply rules from traditional palmistry.
Textos sobre amor y zodiaco escritos por: Texts about love and the zodiac that we wrote, based on the traditional characteristics of each sign and element.
Encuestas cuyas respuestas se suman para: Quizzes whose answers are added up to assign a color. It's a self-discovery game, not a measurement.
La carta astral usa fórmulas astronómica: The birth chart uses astronomical formulas to place the Sun, Moon, and planets at the time and place you enter. We use the tropical zodiac and the Placidus house system, the most common in Western astrology. Near the poles, where Placidus doesn't work, we use the Porphyry system. We compare our positions with the Swiss Ephemeris, which professional software uses, and the difference is less than one arcminute. If you don't know your birth time, you'll see the planets in their signs, but not the rising sign or the houses, because those change every few minutes.
Calculamos la edad de la Luna contando l: We calculate the Moon's age by counting the days since a reference new moon (January 6, 2000) and dividing by the mean synodic cycle of 29.53 days. It's a very good approximation for knowing which phase we're in, but the real Moon varies slightly from one cycle to the next, so the exact moment of a phase can differ by a few hours from astronomical tables.
Nuestros horóscopos son textos que escri: Our horoscopes are texts that we write for each sign and each category, in a guiding tone. The system picks among them based on your sign and the period (day, week, month). That's why two people with the same sign see the same text on the same day. They are not predictions calculated from actual planetary transits; for that, there's the birth chart.
Las cartas se eligen al azar entre las 7: Cards are picked at random from the 78 in the deck. The meaning of each one (22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor) is based on the Rider-Waite tarot tradition and the classic texts that explain it. Each spread is an invitation to reflect, not a prediction.
Asignamos a cada letra un número del 1 a: We assign each letter a number from 1 to 9 according to the Pythagorean table, add them up, and reduce to a single digit. The numbers 11, 22, and 33 are kept as master numbers. The meaning of each number is a traditional interpretation that we write in plain language.
La foto de tu palma se analiza en tu dis: The photo of your palm is analyzed on your device and is not sent to our servers. The reading applies rules from traditional palmistry (lines, mounts, fingers) and shows the visual observation behind each interpretation.
